scripts.check: pnpm check:api && pnpm check:cloudflare && pnpm check:web
scripts.check:api: uv run ruff check apps/api && uv run ruff format --check apps/api && uv run mypy apps/api/src
scripts.check:cloudflare: uv run --project apps/cloudflare ruff check apps/cloudflare && uv run --project apps/cloudflare ruff format --check apps/cloudflare
scripts.db:migrate: uv run alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.format: uv run ruff check --fix apps/api && uv run ruff format apps/api && uv run --project apps/cloudflare ruff check --fix apps/cloudflare && uv run --project apps/cloudflare ruff format apps/cloudflare && biome check --write apps/web
scripts.test: pnpm test:api && pnpm test:cloudflare && pnpm test:web
